cameraInstructions: Film from the side with the shoulder directly above the elbow and the full body visible.

metrics.targetText: Keep the shoulders, hips, and ankles in one straight line.
metrics.hint_good: Your body formed a strong straight line.
metrics.hint_low: Your hips moved away from the body line. Tighten your core and keep the hips level.
metrics.hint_high: Keep the body long without forcing the hips past a comfortable straight line.

metrics.targetText: Keep the shoulder above an elbow bent to about 90 degrees.
metrics.hint_good: Your support elbow stayed in a strong position below the shoulder.
metrics.hint_low: The elbow was folded too tightly. Move it until the forearm support feels close to 90 degrees.
metrics.hint_high: The elbow was too open. Place it directly below the shoulder and bend it closer to 90 degrees.

metrics.targetText: Keep the body line steady while holding the position.
metrics.hint_high: Your hips moved up and down. Brace your core and keep the body quiet.
